summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K disclosing the repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,187.60 per share, total consideration approximately MXN 59.38 million, executed on August 3, 2026, under an April 28, 2026 shareholder-approved buyback program. Post-repurchase, 111,067,402 Series A shares remain outstanding with 1,234,351 held in treasury. Citigroup Mexico acted as broker. This is a routine open-market issuer repurchase under a standing authorization, not a formal tender offer. What to watch: continued repurchase cadence against the approved basket, given shares trade on NYSE and BMV.
